title: 1 Injured in Single-Car Accident on FM 2410 in Harker Heights, TX
description:
Bell County, TX — December 11, 2025: Authorities said a man was seriously injured in a single-vehicle crash that occurred around 5:00 p.m. at the intersection of Farm-to-Market Road 2410 and Cedar Knob Road in Harker Heights. According to officials, a 59-year-old man was driving a southbound Ford F-150 when, for reasons not yet confirmed, the pickup allegedly took evasive action and struck a utility pole. The driver sustained serious injuries and was transported for medical treatment. The individual’s identity has not been released, and additional details remain pending from authorities. The incident remains under investigation.

Video by Brandon Green, Grossman Law Offices
channel: Accident News by Attorney Michael Grossman
